scenes.voiceEn: Learn the rules, one guided hand at a time.
scenes.voiceZh: 跟着互动引导，轻松学会规则。

scenes.voiceEn: Follow every action as the hand unfolds.
scenes.voiceZh: 每一步行动，本手动态实时记录。

scenes.voiceEn: Finish a hand. Tap Review. Understand the decision.
scenes.voiceZh: 打完一手，点开复盘，理解决策。

scenes.voiceEn: Replay the same deal. Try a different decision.
scenes.voiceZh: 重新打同一副牌，换一种决策。

scenes.voiceEn: Open your game records. Revisit every hand.
scenes.voiceZh: 打开对局记录，随时回看每手详情。

scenes.en: Choose the cards. See the odds.
scenes.voiceEn: Choose your cards. Explore the odds.
scenes.voiceZh: 选好底牌和公共牌，看清胜率。
scenes.sharedVoiceEn: See your win rate and count your outs.
scenes.sharedVoiceZh: 看清胜率，也看哪些牌能反超。
